headline: Frostburg State concede seven goals all season
dek: Frostburg State have won 17 matches and drawn three, scoring more goals than any other programme in the conference. They have been beaten twice, not since Point Park in September, and on Friday they beat Slippery Rock, the side that handed them the first of those defeats.
displaced_by: Frostburg State's win over Slippery Rock took their wins from 16 to 17, so the standing dek was no longer true. The headline still holds and stands.
